title: Astrid and the Contact
author: August Pemberton
blurb: Mara Almeida, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
